answer: Audits are recorded in inlet, queued in mesa, and forge publishes the wait time. A farm of 323 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 78 identities per epoch. A farm of 3362 identities would post 4458 proofs and burn roughly 13 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
